description: Create complete React 18 + Vite + TailwindCSS frontend in frontend/ directory. Implement all pages (HomePage with schedule form, PreviewPage showing first 5 rounds + quality metrics with payment button, SuccessPage with download links, Privacy/Terms/Refund static pages) and components (ScheduleForm with dynamic venue/slot rows, VenueRow, SlotRow, PreviewTable, QualityMetrics, PaymentButton, DownloadLinks, Navbar). Implement API client (scheduleApi.js) with fetch calls to backend. Use React Router for navigation. TailwindCSS for styling matching existing Schedule-it brand (blue primary: #2563EB). Environment variable VITE_API_BASE_URL for backend URL (default http://localhost:8000). Complete package.json, vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, Dockerfile, nginx.conf for production, .env.example.
steps: 1. Create frontend/ directory structure: frontend/src/{components,pages,api}, frontend/public.

2. Create frontend/package.json with dependencies: react@18, react-dom@18, react-router-dom@6, vite@5, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss@3, postcss, autoprefixer, eslint, eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks. Scripts: dev (vite), build (vite build), preview (vite preview), lint (eslint src).
3. Create frontend/vite.config.js: import react plugin, set base: '/', server: {port: 5173, proxy: {'/api': {target: 'http://localhost:8000', changeOrigin: true}}}.
4. Create frontend/tailwind.config.js: content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,jsx}'], theme: {extend: {colors: {primary: '#2563EB'}}}.
5. Create frontend/postcss.config.js: export tailwindcss and autoprefixer.
6. Create frontend/src/index.css with Tailwind directives (@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;).

7. Create frontend/src/api/scheduleApi.js with functions: async generateSchedule(requestData) => POST /api/generate, async getJob(jobId) => GET /api/jobs/{jobId}, async createCheckoutSession(jobId) => POST /api/checkout/{jobId}, getDownloadUrl(jobId, format, teamName) => returns URL string. Use VITE_API_BASE_URL env var (default 'http://localhost:8000').
8. Create frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx: logo/title 'Schedule-it', links to /, /privacy, /terms, /refund. Blue header bar.
9. Create frontend/src/components/VenueRow.jsx: input fields for venue name, capacity, remove button. Props: index, venue, onChange, onRemove.
10. Create frontend/src/components/SlotRow.jsx: input fields for date, time, venue_name, remove button. Props: index, slot, onChange, onRemove.

11. Create frontend/src/components/ScheduleForm.jsx: full form with teams textarea, venues array (VenueRow for each, Add Venue button), slots array (SlotRow for each, Add Slot button), blackout_dates textarea, round_robin radio (single/double), derby_pairs textarea, max_consecutive_home/away number inputs. Submit button calls generateSchedule from scheduleApi, handles loading state, navigates to /preview/{job_id} on success, shows error alert on failure.
12. Create frontend/src/components/PreviewTable.jsx: displays matches array in a table (round, date, time, home, away, venue). Props: matches.
13. Create frontend/src/components/QualityMetrics.jsx: displays metrics object (violations, home_away_breaks, balance_score, solve_time_ms, status) in a styled card. Props: metrics.
14. Create frontend/src/components/PaymentButton.jsx: button that calls createCheckoutSession(jobId), redirects to checkout_url on success. Props: jobId, disabled (if already paid).
15. Create frontend/src/components/DownloadLinks.jsx: three links/buttons for PDF, CSV, ICS (with team dropdown for ICS). Uses getDownloadUrl from scheduleApi. Props: jobId, teams.
16. Create frontend/src/pages/HomePage.jsx: renders Navbar + ScheduleForm. Title 'Generate Your Fixture Schedule'.

17. Create frontend/src/pages/PreviewPage.jsx: useParams to get jobId, useEffect to fetch getJob(jobId), displays preview matches (first 5 rounds from response), QualityMetrics, remaining count, PaymentButton if not paid, DownloadLinks if paid. Shows loading spinner while fetching.

18. Create frontend/src/pages/SuccessPage.jsx: useSearchParams to get session_id and job_id, useEffect to poll getJob(jobId) until paid becomes true (webhook may be in-flight), displays 'Payment Successful!' message and DownloadLinks once paid. Shows 'Processing payment...' while waiting.
19. Create frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPage.jsx: Navbar + static Privacy Policy content (placeholder text).
20. Create frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.jsx: Navbar + static Terms of Service content (placeholder text).
21. Create frontend/src/pages/RefundPage.jsx: Navbar + static Refund Policy content (placeholder text).
22. Create frontend/src/App.jsx: import BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, render routes for /, /preview/:jobId, /success, /privacy, /terms, /refund.
23. Create frontend/src/main.jsx: import React, ReactDOM, App, index.css. ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>).

24. Create frontend/index.html: , , with meta charset, viewport, title 'Schedule-it', with
,
25. Create frontend/.env.example: VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000.

26. Create frontend/Dockerfile: FROM node:20-alpine, WORKDIR /app, COPY package*.json ./, RUN npm ci, COPY . ., RUN npm run build, FROM nginx:alpine, COPY --from=0 /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html, COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf, EXPOSE 80.
27. Create frontend/nginx.conf: server listening on 80, root /usr/share/nginx/html, index index.html, location / {try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;}, location /api {proxy_pass http://backend:8000;}.

28. Create frontend/.eslintrc.cjs: basic ESLint config for React (env: browser, es2021, extends: eslint:recommended, plugin:react/recommended, parserOptions: ecmaVersion: latest, sourceType: module, ecmaFeatures: {jsx: true}, settings: {react: {version: detect}}).
29. Create frontend/.gitignore: node_modules, dist, .env.
acceptance_criteria: npm install in frontend/ completes without errors
npm run dev starts Vite dev server on localhost:5173
Visiting localhost:5173 shows HomePage with form
Form submission calls POST /api/generate and navigates to preview on success
PreviewPage fetches job data and displays matches, metrics, payment button
verification: cd frontend && npm run build (ensure no build errors)
Start backend: cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload (in separate terminal)
Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev (in separate terminal)
Open http://localhost:5173 in browser, fill form with 4 teams, 1 venue, 6 slots, submit, verify redirect to preview and data display
